audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart on this page ([Gangplank, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gangplank]) disagrees with the already-audited mirror page, which was set to [Skill, Volibear, Volibear, Gangplank, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank].
audit.why: The two packet charts are direct inverses of each other at rows 1-4 and 6, so one of them is inverted. The mirror side is already written and mirror-fix.js would overwrite any disagreement I introduce, so this page adopts the mirror's rows with inverse ratings.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-6: Skill / Volibear / Volibear / Gangplank / Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank, ratings 5/7/7/3/5/3/3 from Volibear's side. 48.91% over 1192 games supports a Gangplank-favoured late.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] credits 'your Stormbringer all-in' at levels 4-5, but Stormbringer is not available until level 6.
audit.why: Volibear's R is a level-6 unlock at 160/135/110s; the 4-5 window belongs to Gangplank's free-cooldown Powder Keg and his 22s Remove Scurvy.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is the Volibear window (Stormbringer, 160s at rank 1, disables the tower); 4-5 is Gangplank's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states the decisive interaction: Remove Scurvy cures crowd control, so it removes Thundering Smash's stun.
audit.why: Riot's text for Gangplank W: 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.' Volibear's entire trade pattern is built on that stun landing.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy cleanses the stun — it is 22/20/18/16/14s, so commit only after it is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d tell the player to 'track' Powder Keg and 'engage once it is down'. Powder Keg has no cooldown.
audit.why: Kit file lists Powder Keg cd 0, cost 0, range 1000. There is no down-window to wait for; the counterplay is destroying the barrel.
audit.corrected: Shoot the barrel to deny it rather than waiting for a cooldown that does not exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannon Barrage's true damage is never mentioned in the late-game text, which instead credits Volibear's tankiness.
audit.why: Kit flag and Riot text: Cannon Barrage is global (30000 range) true damage, so resistances do not scale against it.
audit.corrected: Past two items his R ignores what you built — resistances do nothing.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Powder Kegs' as a suspect name; it is the plural of the correct 'Powder Keg' and reads naturally. The mirror reached the same conclusion.
audit.corrected: No name change needed, though singular 'Powder Keg' is used in the rewritten lines.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Gangplank down every time Powder Kegs is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: Powder Keg has no cooldown — he re-places it endlessly, and Remove Scurvy (22s at rank 1) cleanses your stun, so 4-5 is his window, not yours.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Gangplank under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer online — 160s at rank 1, and it disables his tower for the dive. Level 6 is the one window where you out-threaten his barrels.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Gangplank to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky still crit-heals your first hit, but his first-item barrel combo chunks you from 1000 range before you ever reach him.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Gangplank can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: Two items in and his Cannon Barrage true damage ignores everything you built. Keep it a side lane and force the fight before he sets a keg chain.

edits.before: At level 2 Gangplank's Parrrley poke and W cleanse put him ahead.
edits.after: At 2 your Q-stun plus Frenzied Maul out-trade his 625-range Parrrley.

edits.before: Level 3 his keg setup and safe poke keep him in control.
edits.after: Level 3 your Sky Splitter shield closes the gap on his kegs.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your Stormbringer all-in beats him before kegs chain.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 his barrel chains and Remove Scurvy cleanse out-value you.

edits.before: At 6 your leap plus E-slow kills him before Cannon Barrage zones you.
edits.after: At 6 your leap and E-slow can beat Cannon Barrage if he has no barrel up.

edits.before: With 2+ items your R and tankiness let you dive through the kegs.
edits.after: With 2+ items his crit barrels and true-damage R out-scale your dives.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 belong to Gangplank: his Q crit-poke and W cleanse chip you safely — but your level-6 Stormbringer all-in, landed before his kegs chain, swings that fight to you.
edits.after: Level 3 is yours once Sky Splitter lands, but 4-5 swing back: Powder Keg has no cooldown and Remove Scurvy cleanses your stun (22s). Level 6 is your window — Stormbringer before a chain.

edits.before: His first-item barrel spike is dangerous, but with 2+ items your R re-cast and tankiness let you dive through the kegs and lock him down before a full detonation.
edits.after: His first-item barrel spike is dangerous and it only grows: past two items Cannon Barrage deals true damage, so resistances do nothing. Force the fight before he places a keg.

edits.before: Late you can dive him — your R re-cast and tankiness let you reach him through his barrels and lock him down before he detonates a full chain, but flanking him mid-keg-setup is how you win.
edits.after: Late he out-scales you — Cannon Barrage is true damage on 120s at rank 3 and his barrels chain for free, so dive him mid-keg-setup with Stormbringer's 550 leap or don't fight him at all.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Gangplank Powder Keg: Places barrels that chain-explode when shot — his combo + poke. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Powder Keg: matchup-defining — no cooldown at all, 1000 range; he re-places it, so deny the barrel by attacking it first. - Remove Scurvy: 22s at rank 1, and it cleanses your Thundering Smash stun.

edits.before: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Powder Keg has no cooldown — shoot the barrel to deny it, don't wait it out.

edits.before: Track Gangplank's Powder Kegs: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. When it is down — Q-stun + all-in him.
edits.after: Powder Keg has no cooldown — shoot barrels, don't wait. Remove Scurvy cleanses your stun; it is 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: Charging Q into a waiting Powder Kegs — losing the stun before you land it means you took the whole trade for nothing and your W mark expires un-cashed.
edits.after: Q-stunning into a ready Remove Scurvy — he cleanses it on the spot, so the whole trade goes for nothing and your W mark still expires un-cashed.

notes: The two packet level charts for this matchup are direct inverses of each other (volibear's packet says Gangplank wins L2-L3 and Volibear wins L4-5 and 2+ items; gangplank's packet says the reverse). I adopted the mirror's already-written chart. If the user believes volibear's packet is the correct one, both pages need flipping together, not this one alone. Whether Remove Scurvy can be used pre-emptively for CC immunity or only cleanses after the stun lands is not in Riot's text — all advice here is written as cleansing after it connects.
